name: BECHTLE AG O.N.
summary: Bechtle AG provides information technology services to customers in the public sector as well as small, medium-sized and large enterprises. The company operates through IT System House & Managed Services and IT E-Commerce segments, offering services such as IT strategy consulting, hardware and software sales, project planning, system integration, and IT services. Bechtle AG is headquartered in Neckarsulm, Germany.
